title: SHA-256 Checksum
description: Hashes the whole file so any single-bit change is detectable. Recorded facts — Check: SHA-256 Checksum; Detects: corruption; Mechanism: hash compare. Used by build pipelines, data publishers, and archives to trust generated artifacts.
demo:
# SHA-256 Checksum — runnable demo (python3)
# SHA-256 Checksum - determinism and size (python3)
import hashlib
content='file-bytes-v1'
min_bytes=100
h1=hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()
h2=hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()
print("sha256:", h1[:16], "bytes:", len(content.encode()))
print("OK" if h1==h2 and len(content.encode())>=min_bytes else "FAIL")
